title: Ed Davey calls for immediate 10p cut to fuel duty
summary: Ed Davey is calling for a 10p reduction in fuel duty, attributing rising fuel costs to Trump's conflict with Iran and its impact on the UK economy. The proposed cut aims to provide relief amid elevated energy prices.
content: Sir Ed blamed Donald Trump's war with Iran for damaging the UK economy and pushing fuel prices up.

zh.title: 埃德·戴维呼吁立即削减燃油税10便士
zh.summary: 埃德·戴维呼吁削减燃油税10便士，并将不断上升的燃油成本归咎于特朗普与伊朗的冲突及其对英国经济的影响。提议的削减旨在在能源价格高企的情况下提供救济。

title: Family shares hidden cost of cancer care
summary: A family discusses the financial and personal burden of cancer care after their daughter Maya was diagnosed with neuroblastoma at age three. The story highlights hidden costs beyond direct medical treatment.
content: Maya, 13, from Hythe in Kent, was diagnosed with neuroblastoma when she was three.

zh.title: 一家人分享癌症治疗的隐性成本
zh.summary: 一家人讨论了他们女儿玛雅在三岁时被诊断为神经母细胞瘤后的癌症治疗的财务和个人负担。这个故事突出了超越直接医疗治疗的隐性成本。

title: Ed Sheeran calls Israel's treatment of Gazans 'unjustifiable,' apologizes for Macklemore controversy
summary: Ed Sheeran addressed the Israel-Gaza conflict at a concert, calling Israel's treatment of Gazans "unjustifiable" while also condemning the October 2023 Hamas attack as "horrific," and apologized for a prior Macklemore-related controversy.
content: At the start of the concert at Lincoln Financial Field, Sheeran called the October 2023 Hamas attack that killed 1,200 Israelis "horrific."

zh.title: 埃德·希兰称以色列对加沙人民的待遇"难以接受"，为Macklemore争议道歉
zh.summary: 埃德·希兰在演唱会上针对以色列-加沙冲突进行了讲话，称以色列对加沙人民的待遇"难以接受"，同时也谴责了2023年10月哈马斯的袭击为"可怕的"，并为之前与Macklemore相关的争议道歉。

title: U.S. Treasury's Bessent, China's He to hold talks on AI, trade, critical minerals: Reuters
summary: The U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and China's representative He are scheduled to hold diplomatic talks covering artificial intelligence, trade relations, and critical mineral sourcing. These discussions represent continued engagement on key economic and strategic areas.

zh.title: 美国财政部长贝森特与中国代表何举行关于人工智能、贸易和关键矿产的会谈
zh.summary: 美国财政部长贝森特和中国代表何计划举行外交谈判，涵盖人工智能、贸易关系和关键矿物采购。这些讨论代表了在关键经济和战略领域的持续接触。

title: Families missing out on NHS money for healthy food
summary: New figures reveal that only about 64% of eligible families are claiming NHS funds intended for healthy food purchases, indicating potential barriers to accessing nutrition support. This gap suggests missed opportunities for improving family health outcomes.
content: Figures show as few as 64% of eligible families are claiming NHS money to buy milk, fruit and veg.

zh.title: 家庭错过了用于健康食品的国民健康服务资金
zh.summary: 新数据显示，只有约64%的符合条件的家庭申领了用于健康食品购买的国民健康服务资金，表明在获得营养支持方面存在潜在障碍。这一差距表明了改善家庭健康成果的机会被错失。

title: France’s wine production nears a 70-year low, leaving winemakers with tough choices
summary: France's wine production has declined to near 70-year lows, forcing winemakers to explore alternative strategies including new markets, product diversification, and generational planning. The crisis reflects significant challenges to the nation's iconic industry.
content: As the French wine industry reaches a crisis point, key players are considering new markets, products and generations.

zh.title: 法国葡萄酒产量接近70年低点，使葡萄酒生产商面临艰难选择
zh.summary: 法国葡萄酒产量下降到接近70年来的低点，迫使葡萄酒生产商探索替代战略，包括开拓新市场、产品多元化和代际规划。这一危机反映了这个民族标志性产业面临的重大挑战。

title: ‘I’m burned out’: I’m constantly helping my cousin who is running out of money. Is it too much to expect his sister to help?
summary: A reader describes the burnout of repeatedly providing financial and material support to a struggling cousin, raising questions about family obligations and fair distribution of caregiving responsibilities. The column explores the emotional and financial toll of extended family support.
content: “I spend a lot of time away from my family and spend money on gas, taking him out to eat.”

zh.title: "我感到筋疲力尽"：我不断地帮助经济困难的表亲。期望他的妹妹提供帮助太过分吗？
zh.summary: 一位读者描述了反复向陷入困境的表亲提供财务和物质支持所带来的倦怠感，引发了关于家庭义务和照顾责任公平分配的问题。该专栏探讨了大家庭支持带来的情感和经济代价。
